meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS RUNTIME TREE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-runtime SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

blackboard.var: Build a playable, offline 2D sandbox game inspired by Minecraft. Must run by opening index.html, no build step, external libraries, CDNs, or network access. Save progress and document controls. Work only in /work.

node.title: Prepare work order
node.instructions: Read the project bridge, open the work order through xc-open-work-order, validate requested feature IDs without creating features, determine and validate work_order.document_language through xc-document from the explicit parameter or initiating user request, and record the requested scope. Write the report commitment work_order.requires_report in this same preparation step, resolved through the report policy rather than from the mode alone: an explicit user instruction first, then the project bridge which may only tighten, then report.default in the workshop configuration, then the built-in default. The shipped code-change-only tier means true for create, change, repair, and maintenance and false for investigation and review, and true when the mode cannot be confirmed, because an unknown mode is never interpreted as no report needed. Record work_order.report_skip_reason whenever the report is deliberately skipped, and capture work_order.report_baseline once, as the baseline commit, the worktree digest and the digest algorithm, and only when that resolved commitment is true: a work order that resolves to no report captures nothing, and the record keeps its three values and its publishable --format keys form. Where version control is unusable for the repository - it is not a worktree, or no baseline commit is resolvable - the capture fails closed and copies nothing; a full copy is admissible only through the explicit consent opt-in of the capture command, whose reference must name the user's explicit decision obtained through a main-session gate, and no new configuration item exists for it. The commitment, the initial report strength and, when the commitment is true, the baseline record are preparation-phase records, never retrospective notes, and a missing commitment fails this node.
node.deliverables: An authoritative workbench and explicit feature associations.
node.acceptance: The workbench is independent, feature associations are explicit, work_order.document_language is set before any document write, no unmanaged feature directory was created, and the mode-derived report commitment is written rather than assumed: work_order.requires_report carries the value the resolved report policy produced, every skip records one of the legal work_order.report_skip_reason values (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default), work_order.report_baseline records the baseline commit, the worktree digest and the digest algorithm only when the resolved commitment is true, a capture where version control was unusable failed closed with nothing copied unless the explicit consent opt-in of the capture command carried a reference naming the user's explicit decision, and a missing commitment fails this node.

result.summary: Workbench opened; bridge, language, report waiver, and L1 convention discovery recorded.
result.validation: L1 scan completed; language en validated; convention record validated; report commitment=false with user_waived.

node.title: Define work order goal
node.instructions: Author goal.md through xc-document, including requested outcome, intended capability scope, quality contract, concrete comparison target, material exclusions with provenance, and reference-informed signature experience challenge.
node.deliverables: Validated work-order goal document at artifacts/goal.md.
node.acceptance: Frontmatter is valid; requested outcome and capability scope are explicit; quality contract and comparison target are concrete; every exclusion or added constraint has user/project/goal-authored provenance; no material goal-authored exclusion is binding.

result.summary: Goal authored with requested outcome, capability scope, quality contract, Minecraft comparison, signature musts, constraints, and acceptance conditions.
result.validation: xc-document work-order-goal validation passed; no material exclusions; all constraints have provenance.

node.title: Collect sandbox design evidence
node.instructions: Analyze the create request against the goal. Produce the capability map (source, priority, user value, acceptance, exact verification), stateful journey/integrity rows for persistence, rejection, reset and empty inventory, signature-experience table for Minecraft, output-surface profile visual, constraints, alternatives, and risks. Distinguish facts from hypotheses.
node.deliverables: Internal evidence artifact at artifacts/analysis-evidence.md with capability map, journeys, signature decisions, risks, and recommendation.
node.acceptance: Every requested must capability is covered; the visual surface profile is selected; journeys have before/action/after and executable probes; Minecraft signatures are dispositioned; no unsourced exclusion or unresolved required decision remains.

result.summary: Evidence collected: seed state, constraints, capability map, stateful journeys, Minecraft signature table, alternatives, and risks.
result.validation: Node artifact validated; capability map covers every must; visual profile selected; journeys include before/action/after and probes.

node.title: Synthesize work-order analysis
node.instructions: Synthesize accepted evidence into analysis.md through xc-document. Include evidence/current state, request-to-goal comparison, capability map, signature table, stateful journeys, alternatives, impact/risks, and the recommended small-Minecraft scope. Do not invent facts or narrow the goal silently.
node.deliverables: Validated work-order analysis document at artifacts/analysis.md.
node.acceptance: Document validation passes; capability map is complete and maps must capabilities to verification; alternatives and risks are present; no unsourced exclusion; accepted facts are distinguishable from hypotheses.

result.summary: Analysis synthesized: capability map, visual profile, Minecraft signatures, journeys, alternatives, risks, and accepted scope.
result.validation: xc-document work-order-analysis validation passed; capability map complete; recommendation and release triggers recorded.

node.title: Select work order solution
node.instructions: Author solution.md through xc-document. Record task type, scope decision, accepted capability matrix mapping every must/should to implementation and verification, file/interface plan, data/save format, visual and experience checks, implementation boundary, version disposition, and verification strategy. No prior capability inventory applies.
node.deliverables: Validated work-order solution document at artifacts/solution.md.
node.acceptance: Document validation passes; every must capability maps to implementation and verification; no silent exclusion; scope boundary and version disposition recorded; solution gate can decide from it.

result.summary: Solution selected: vanilla 2D finite tile sandbox with testable pure modules, DOM UI, procedural art/audio, diff save, and full capability matrix.
result.validation: Solution document validated; every must/should maps to implementation and verification; scope boundary and version disposition recorded.

node.title: Approve work order solution
node.instructions: Present the selected change solution, baseline impact, implementation strategy, verification strategy, and unresolved decisions. Record approval or add revision nodes.
node.deliverables: An approval decision or explicit revision work.
node.acceptance: Implementation cannot proceed on a material unresolved solution decision.

result.summary: Solution approved: the capability matrix covers every must, scope is bounded to the requested pocket sandbox, and no material decision is unresolved.
result.validation: Selected solution artifact and control packet reviewed; 1/1 source with artifact; no blockers.
result.decision: Approved under the user mandate to build the requested game. The solution preserves every requested capability, adds no binding exclusion, and records a concrete verification strategy. Proceed with implementation.

node.title: Implement world, inventory, physics, and save foundations
node.instructions: Implement the approved pure foundations: config registries, seeded RNG/noise, world generation and block/light APIs, inventory/crafting, player physics, and save encoding/diff/validation. Add focused Node tests. Preserve seed API compatibility. Keep UTF-8/LF and no network or libraries.
node.deliverables: Foundation modules and tests plus artifact at artifacts/implementation-foundations.md.
node.acceptance: Modules load in Node and browser; world generates deterministic layered terrain with caves/ores/trees; inventory and recipes enforce stack/tier/station rules; physics collides/jumps; save round-trips and rejects corruption; focused tests pass.

result.summary: Pure foundations implemented: config registries, seeded world/light, inventory/crafting, physics, and save validation.
result.validation: 24/24 Node tests pass; seed compatibility preserved; convention record consumed; browser integration deferred to next node.

node.title: Implement renderer, UI, audio, and game loop
node.instructions: Implement the approved browser product: procedural textures, sky/parallax/world/light/player rendering, UI overlays and HUD, procedural audio, and the main game loop with input, mining/placing, crafting, saving, tutorial, pause/death/reset, and responsive behavior. Preserve #game #status #hud #hotbar. No external assets.
node.deliverables: Playable browser game plus artifact at artifacts/implementation-game.md.
node.acceptance: Opening index.html yields Play/Help first run; movement, mining, placement, inventory, crafting, torch light, save/reload, pause, death/respawn, sound toggle, minimap, and quests work; no console errors or network requests.

result.summary: Browser game implemented and playable: procedural rendering, HUD/UI, input, mining/placement, crafting, light, save/load, health, quests, and audio.
result.validation: page_check green; 25/25 Node tests; 34/34 browser probe checks; 10/10 pointer clicks; 60.4 fps; no external requests or console errors; manual furnace/iron, cave torch, death, reset, and inventory flows pass.

node.title: Document controls and polish the delivered product
node.instructions: Rewrite README.md with the game description, offline launch, complete controls, systems, save behavior, architecture, and verification commands. Review the running product for visual, responsive, interaction, and copy polish, and correct any defects found without adding unapproved systems. Keep the in-game controls authoritative.
node.deliverables: Updated README.md and polish fixes plus artifact at artifacts/implementation-docs.md.
node.acceptance: README matches actual controls and behavior; in-game help covers every key; no stale seed wording; visual and responsive defects found during review are fixed; seed tests still pass.

result.summary: README and final product polish completed; controls, save behavior, layout, overlay feedback, cave visibility, and reset guard corrected.
result.validation: Docs/UI/code conventions followed; 25/25 unit tests, page check, and 34/34 final browser probe checks pass; screenshots refreshed.

node.title: Verify Emberblock against the accepted capability matrix
node.instructions: Execute verification_scope=regression using project-defined commands and the visual output-surface profile: node tests, page_check, play_probe, real-pointer 10/10, first-run affordance, visual-state backdrop, responsive UI, persistence, refusal, corrupt-save, reset, death and station journeys. Map evidence to every must/should capability and record gaps. Do not modify product behavior.
node.deliverables: Internal verification artifact at artifacts/verification.md with command outcomes, capability/journey mapping, visual evidence, and residual gaps.
node.acceptance: Every must capability has executed evidence; visual first-run, interaction truth, state backdrop, and responsive checks pass; seed checks and new tests pass; no external requests or console errors; gaps are explicit.

result.summary: Verification passed: 25/25 tests, page check green, 34/34 browser checks, 10/10 pointer truth, 60.7 fps, capability matrix and stateful journeys evidenced.
result.validation: All must capabilities pass with executed evidence; visual first-run, backdrop, responsive and interaction truth pass; no external requests or console errors; should-level audio-quality gap and fixed-aspect risk recorded.

node.title: Produce change review report
node.instructions: Produce the change report for this work order after verification and before the result document. The group is mounted by the commitment value work_order.requires_report. Embed the xc-change-report subtree once under this group, or run a single role=report node that carries the same contract. Resolve the subtree's template path from the committed setup record at .agents/.xcoding-setup/manifest.json, which holds the installed xc-change-report package's absolute path; change-report-template.xml is read from it, and the host-to-Skill-root table is the fallback for a project with no such record. Before the group's first node runs, publish all thirteen caller-seeded keys with the values this work order actually uses, never merely accepting their declared defaults: report.path, report.manifest_path, report.baseline_commit, report.baseline_digest, report.language, report.strength, report.gate_required, report.gate_outcome, report.gate_rework_required, report.gate_recovery_required, report.round, report.refresh_count, and report.refresh_reason. report.round is the 1-based index of the pass being entered. When prepare-manifest measures one or more analyzable units, produce the report; when it measures zero analyzable units, record work_order.report_skip_reason=zero_analyzable_units and produce no report; a user waiver records work_order.report_skip_reason=user_waived, and a skip the resolved report policy produced records work_order.report_skip_reason=policy_default. A skipped gate records report.gate_outcome=not-run, never accepted.
node.deliverables: On the produced outcome: one change-report.html, one change-report-manifest.json, and one change-report-verdicts.json under the workbench report node artifact directory. On the skipped outcome: no report file is required, and the deliverable is the recorded work_order.report_skip_reason with report.run_required=false.
node.acceptance: Exactly one of the two outcomes holds: either the report exists at report.path and is proven by report.manifest_path, or report.run_required is false and work_order.report_skip_reason records one of the legal reasons (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default); a produced report is never accepted without its manifest, and a skip is never accepted without its reason. The caller publishes all thirteen caller-seeded report.* keys with the values this work order uses before the group's first node runs, and the subtree's template is resolved from the installed package path the setup record holds, so the guards and completion-fact selectors the subtree evaluates resolve against those thirteen declarations or against a key one of the subtree's own nodes writes before that expression reads it.

node.title: Record work order result
node.instructions: Author result.md through xc-document. Record actual changes, validation evidence, baseline synchronization, deviations/residual risks, report waiver, and the player-facing outcome. Publish the result source ID.
node.deliverables: Validated work-order result document at artifacts/result.md.
node.acceptance: Result accurately reports delivered scope and evidence, contains the report waiver line, records residual risks, and validates as work-order-result.

result.summary: Result recorded: playable offline Emberblock, full evidence set, waived report, residual risks, and controls.
result.validation: xc-document work-order-result validation passed; report waiver and skip reason recorded; no feature baseline or version policy applicable.

node.title: Finalize ordinary work order
node.instructions: Confirm the work order result, declared artifacts, feature baseline synchronization, code provenance, and residual risks, then close the work order. Consume work_order.report_skip_reason: when work_order.requires_report is true and neither a report path nor one of the legal skip reasons (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default) is recorded, the work order must not close.
node.deliverables: A completed, failed, or blocked work order with durable evidence.
node.acceptance: The runtime tree and workbench documents accurately describe the work order outcome, and a committed report obligation is either satisfied by a report path or explicitly recorded as a skip decision.

result.summary: Finalized Emberblock: approved solution delivered, all must capabilities verified, controls and README documented, report obligation explicitly waived, no project commit created.
result.validation: Result and goal source artifacts present; verification evidence 25/25 tests, page check green, 34/34 browser checks, 10/10 pointer truth; report waived with user_waived; residual risks recorded; finalizer packet ready.
